correctness.rationale: For all integer page counts at least two, grounded Laplacian convention and leader quantifiers are explicit. The two-terminal effective resistance Green identity follows by minimizing the injection-energy quadratic. Five resistance classes follow from series-parallel and symmetry calculations. Six closed rational objective forms cover every unordered pair and strict sign factorizations isolate exactly the three optimum regimes. Independent exact rational Gauss-Jordan replay checked 708 leader placements and 30 resistance entries for small instances; the full proof is analytical, not an inference from those samples.

value.rationale: The quadrilateral book is a canonical star prism with a common communications edge and parallel short paths. Under the most basic nontrivial fixed two-leader budget, all optimal placements and counts exhibit two sharp structural changes as page count grows, rather than a routine scalar bound. The full six-orbit rational classification supplies interpretable design rules and quantitative comparisons for a natural infinite family.
